name: vite-react-ts-template
comment: The canonical Vite + React + TS starter, scaffolded from the official template. Smallest plain SPA shape: a handful of .tsx files under src/ with a single tsconfig. Baseline that every real React app is a superset of.

name: radix-primitives
comment: Radix UI primitives: a barrel-heavy, deeply-nested component library (dozens of packages each re-exporting via `export * from`). Stresses import/reference resolution across many index.ts barrels and PascalCase .tsx components, exactly the renders/calls recall surface.

name: shadcn-ui-monorepo
comment: A real turborepo monorepo (apps/* + packages/*). Pointing root at apps/www makes the engine walk up to the turbo.json root and index the whole workspace, exercising depends-on (package->package) and multi-package discovery.

name: nextjs-commerce
comment: Vercel's Next.js Commerce: a non-`src` App-Router layout (app/, components/, lib/) with server + client components. Proves the engine indexes Next.js conventions driven by the repo's own tsconfig rather than a hard-coded src/ allowlist.

name: excalidraw
comment: Excalidraw: a large, real-world React + TS canvas app inside a yarn-workspaces monorepo. High file count and dense intra-package calls/renders — a throughput and recall stress test (will brush against maxFilesPerPackage).

name: react-hook-form
comment: react-hook-form: a single-package, hook-heavy TS library (mostly .ts, few components). Proves the function-node / `calls`-edge path on a codebase that is almost all functions and almost no JSX.

name: cal-com
comment: Cal.com: a very large Next.js turborepo (apps/* + packages/*). The heaviest entry in the corpus — many workspace packages and thousands of files. Validates discovery, the per-package file budget, and that one slow/huge repo can't break the run.
